metadata.title: Positivity of the canonical bundle and Hermitian metrics with quasi-negative holomorphic sectional curvature
metadata.abstract: We prove that if a compact Kähler manifold admits a Hermitian metric with quasi-negative holomorphic sectional curvature for the Chern connection, then its canonical bundle is ample. The Hermitian metric realizing this curvature need not be Kähler. This proves the Kähler case of the quasi-negative conjecture of Yang and Zheng.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: Hermitian 准负全纯截曲率推出 canonical ample
analysis.workSummary: 证明紧 Kähler 流形若承载 Chern 连接意义下准负全纯截曲率的 Hermitian 度量，则 canonical bundle ample；该 Hermitian 度量不必 Kähler。
analysis.breakthrough: 证明 Yang–Zheng 准负猜想的 Kähler 流形情形。
analysis.limitations: 底层流形必须紧 Kähler；度量不必 Kähler 不等于取消流形的 Kähler 条件。
analysis.priorityReason: 证明 Yang–Zheng 准负猜想的 Kähler 流形情形。
